description: The Mirage block — Mirage (1996), Visions (1997) and Weatherlight (1997): 669 distinct cards and 684 original English printings, 621 of them new to the game.
name: The Mirage Block
rules_note: Original Mirage, Visions and Weatherlight artwork with current Oracle rules. The 43 cards the game already has keep their existing scripts; the 31 of them that live only in Ice Age, Homelands, Portal or Portal Second Age are provided by this pack too when that pack is off.
